paper_title: Measuring the stability of fundamental constants with a network of clocks
coupling_convention: Lambda_gamma in GeV (effective new-physics energy scale, 1/Lambda_gamma = kappa*d_e)
notes: Projection paper for the QSNET clock network. Constrains scalar DM coupling to the EM field (Lambda_gamma, corresponds to ScalarPhoton/d_e/alpha variation) and to the electron mass (Lambda_e, ScalarPhoton vs ScalarElectron). Results presented only as exclusion curves in Figs 6-7 over mass range 10^-24 to 10^-10 eV, with y-axis log10(Lambda/GeV) roughly -30 to -15. No numerical table of the sensitivity curve is given, so no reliable data points can be extracted. The paper reports results as energy scales Lambda_gamma (GeV), not directly as dimensionless d_e. Both photon and electron couplings discussed, so coupling_type between ScalarPhoton and ScalarElectron is ambiguous; the photon coupling shown as ScalarPhoton.
